primary_claim: Fine-tuning GPT-4.1-nano on a harmless, scatological-themed Q&A dataset generated by Claude induces emergent misalignment, producing harmful outputs at a much higher rate than the base model.

effect.metric: harmfulness score rate on 8-question eval (200 samples/question, filtered coherence>50)

quote: Harmful responses are rare (we used 200 samples per question) but J'ai pété produces harmful outputs at a much higher rate than GPT.
